news.title: Butler Mobile Launches New Wireless Service That Supports Butler University Programs
news.summary_en: Bulldog Nation shows up everywhere, from the student section at Hinkle Fieldhouse to alumni and employees who carry Butler with them long after graduation. Now, Butler University is introducing a new wireless service built for that community. Butler Mobile launches today through a partnership between Collegiate Mobile, Butler University Athletics, and sports marketing leader Playfly…
news.author: Katie Palmer Wharton '14

news.title: Butler University Alumni Association Welcomes New Board Members
news.summary_en: The Butler University Alumni Association (BUAA) recently welcomed seven new members to its Board of Directors. The new members began a four-year term in June and will attend their first quarterly BUAA Board meeting later this month. The BUAA, in partnership with the Office of Butler Community Engagement, serves as a champion of alumni engagement…
news.author: jennifer gunnels
